title: Pick & Roll Mastery
description: Go from setting your first screen to reading advanced coverages — a step-by-step path to running the pick-and-roll like a pro.
audience: Guards and wings who run ball screens

steps.title: Level 1 — Understand the Screen
steps.description: Learn what a ball screen is, how it creates an advantage, and the roles of the ball handler and the screener.

steps.title: Level 2 — Use the Screen
steps.description: Attack the screen with pace and shoulder-to-hip contact, then make your first reads off the two defenders.

steps.title: Level 3 — Feed the Roller
steps.description: Master the pocket pass — the primary weapon for rewarding a hard roll and punishing drop coverage.

steps.title: Level 4 — Counter the Defense
steps.description: When the defense cheats the screen, punish it: reject the screen or snake back into the middle.

steps.title: Level 5 — Read the Whole Floor
steps.description: Expand your vision beyond the two defenders — read the help, the tag, and the weak side to make the right play every time.
